entities.title: Modules build, hash and load
entities.summary: zazzled's tests build the Lua module, serve it over local HTTP, download it, check its hash, load it with dlopen and parse Lua with it; the release script test builds one module and checks its manifest line.
criteria: A module built with one feature exports ZAZZLE_LANGUAGE_ABI and a working zazzle_language.
language-modules.sh writes one `NAME SHA256 FILE` line per module, matching the file.

A rehearsal on Linux built all 34 modules (89 MB) in a few minutes, built zazzled with their manifest (6.8 MB, from 82.4 MB with the grammars linked in) and downloaded, verified and used them through a local HTTP server; a tampered download and a corrupted local copy were refused and replaced.
